GENERAL WEATHER FORECAST FOR NEXT 36 HOURS
Issued at 04.00 p.m. on 28 January 2026
Mainly dry weather will prevail in the most parts of the island.
Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central and North-
western provinces and in Badulla, Galle, Matara and Anuradhapura districts during the early hours
of the morning.
